entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Murtaza Ali And 3 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Atul Kumar Singh

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Kshitij Shailendra,J.
No one has put in appearance on behalf of the petitioners even in the revised call.

This writ petition has been filed with the following prayers:-
"(A) Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of Certiorari quashing the F.I.R.
dated 15.08.2021 in Case Crime No.- 0047 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 376,
377, 313, 506, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District Rampur be quashed, in the interest of justice.

Murtaza Ali And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/193769287/
1 (B) Issue a writ, order or direct in the nature of Mandamus directing the respondent Authorities not to arrest the petitioners, in Case Crime No.- 0047 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 376, 377, 313, 506, 504 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.- Mahila Thana, District Rampur dated 15.08.2021 be stayed, in the interest of justice,
otherwise the petitioners shall suffer huge irreparable loss and injury."
